subject: the entity page, in detail
body:
An entity page carries article and publication totals, the first and latest mention, mentions over the last thirty days against the thirty before, and the recent articles with the relation type behind each one.

One account in the graph, Brex, reads 66 articles across 31 publications with mentions moving from 17 to 27 month over month. That is the shape a signal takes when it has provenance behind it.

I can pull it for a handful of accounts you already track, so you can compare it against what your signals return for the same names.
